dimensions.label: Role Positioning
dimensions.description: How clearly the CV positions the candidate for the target role.

dimensions.label: Evidence Quality
dimensions.description: How grounded the claims are in concrete examples, ownership, and outcomes.

dimensions.label: Impact / Outcomes
dimensions.description: How clearly business, delivery, or transformation outcomes are demonstrated.

dimensions.label: Scope / Complexity
dimensions.description: How well the CV conveys organizational, program, technical, or systems scale.

dimensions.label: Functional / Technical Depth
dimensions.description: How clearly the candidate demonstrates meaningful depth for the target family.

dimensions.label: Influence / Collaboration
dimensions.description: How clearly the candidate shows leadership, stakeholder influence, or cross-functional alignment.

dimensions.label: CV Clarity / ATS
dimensions.description: How scanable, readable, and well-structured the CV is.
